name: fasd
description: Command-line productivity booster offering quick access to files and directories with frecency tracking

install_guidance.note: fasd is a shell integration tool. After installation, add 'eval "$(fasd --init auto)"' to your shell config (.bashrc, .zshrc, etc.) to enable the 'z' and 'f' aliases. Benchmark: 10x faster than cd for deep directory trees.
